changelog: crestock_alternative_allowed filter: whether a product may be shown under the form while a sold-out item is chosen, asked before the list is cut to the shop's limit, so a product turned down leaves its place to the next best seller (docs/HOOKS.md). For products that must never show there.

While the chosen item can't be ordered, only quantity (.quantity) and Add to cart (.single_add_to_cart_button) are hidden, not their whole container (.woocommerce-variation-add-to-cart), so what other plugins print there stays: Kadence Shop Kit's Size guide, wishlist buttons. Before, the Size guide went on every product sold out in every size and whenever a sold-out size was chosen.

On a product sold out in every size, pressing Notify me before choosing one keeps "Sold out in every width" above the form; the error by the button, aria-invalid and the focus move are unchanged. With the inline form, any error shown by a field now leaves the status line for the chosen item as it was.

items/{id}/alternatives takes only the site's languages for locale (its own, en_US, or one in get_available_languages()), so a made-up locale is answered and cached as the default instead of getting a cache entry of its own.
